description: An unfinished (active or deferred) Countdown keeps episode, count and references through a second Setup 9; a completed one is replaced afresh.

Bar 24 (close 83) is a second same-side Setup 9: replaced_episode_id = 13, perfection (T=84, min(l23=84,l24=82)), no countdown_start; the active Countdown keeps episode 13 and bar5/bar8 and counts 10. 25: 84<=l23=84 (11); 26: 81<=l24=82 (12); 27: close 84, l27=84<=l25=84; the qualifier tests l27=84 against the ORIGINAL X=85: passes -> count 13 + complete. A Countdown re-referenced at 24 (Y=83) would defer.
